name: delegate-guard
description: Nudges the main agent to delegate to subagents when it pulls too much material into its own context, and records nudge stats per session.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Nudge the main agent to delegate when its own context grows too fast.

outputCharThreshold.title: Output character threshold
outputCharThreshold.description: Fire the volume nudge when read-only tool output in the main thread exceeds this many characters in one turn.

distinctFileThreshold.title: Distinct files read threshold
distinctFileThreshold.description: Fire the breadth nudge when the main thread has read this many distinct files in one turn.

searchCallThreshold.title: Search call threshold
searchCallThreshold.description: Fire the search nudge after this many Grep, Glob or read-only search commands in one turn.

editFileThreshold.title: Edited files threshold
editFileThreshold.description: Fire the edits nudge when the main thread has edited this many distinct files in one turn.
